description: v1's merge-trio in clash form (SPEC §5.6, §15.7): three player Capguards stand in a triangle, eligible at once. They start knitting at the first check (tick 10, in the muster) and become one Bloomed Capguard at tick 30. The general's lone Tender never attacks, so nothing breaks the knit, and the Bloomed Capguard then wipes it.
